description: Pending/open purchase order filtered by material or item name
sql_template: SELECT PO.ORDERNO, PO.ORDERDATE, PO.SUP_CODE, PO.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, PO.QTY, PO.RATE, PO.NET, PO.STATUS, PO.GRN_PENDINGSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON PO.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY PO.ORDERDATE DESC NULLS LAST, PO.ORDERNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified pending purchase order by material/item-name pattern. It joins PURCHASEORDER with INVITEMS and filters by INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME. STATUS and GRN_PENDINGSTATUS are shown but not filtered because numeric status meanings are not confirmed.

description: Purchase order summary totals filtered by material or item name
sql_template: SELECT INV.ITEM_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT PO.ORDERNO) AS ORDER_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS LINE_COUNT, SUM(NVL(PO.QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PO_QTY, SUM(NVL(PO.NET, 0)) AS TOTAL_PO_VALUE FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON PO.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' GROUP BY INV.ITEM_NAME
explanation: Uses verified purchase order summary by item name with order counts and total quantities/values.

description: Latest purchase order date for an item, filtered by item name
sql_template: SELECT * FROM (SELECT PO.ORDERNO, PO.ORDERDATE AS LAST_PURCHASE_DATE, PO.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME AS COMPANY_NAME, PO.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, PO.QTY, PO.RATE, PO.NET, PO.STATUS, PO.GRN_PENDINGSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON PO.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON PO.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY PO.ORDERDATE DESC NULLS LAST, PO.ORDERNO DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
explanation: Returns the latest purchase order for an item by item name, including supplier/company name as COMPANY_NAME. The query orders by ORDERDATE descending and returns the most recent row using ROWNUM.

description: Latest goods receipt date for an item, filtered by item name
sql_template: SELECT * FROM (SELECT G.GRNNO, G.GRNDATE AS LAST_RECEIVED_DATE, G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, G.ORDERNO, G.CODE AS ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, G.QTY, G.INVQTY, G.ORDERQTY, G.PENDING, G.STATUS, G.REJECTIONSTATUS, G.GRNAUTHSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.GRN G JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON G.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY G.GRNDATE DESC NULLS LAST, G.GRNNO DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
explanation: Returns the latest goods receipt for an item by item name, ordered by GRNDATE descending and limited to the most recent row using ROWNUM.

description: User-friendly item stock availability by item name, including items with no STOCK row
sql_template: SELECT INV.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, NVL(S.STOCK, 0) AS STOCK, NVL(S.STOCKVALUE, 0) AS STOCKVALUE, NVL(S.RESERVEDQTY, 0) AS RESERVEDQTY, NVL(S.INDENTQTY, 0) AS INDENTQTY, NVL(S.TRANSFERQTY, 0) AS TRANSFERQTY, INV.UOMCODE, INV.DEPTCODE, INV.STKGROUPCODE, INV.HSNCODE, INV.GSTTYPECODE, INV.STATUS, INV.OBSOLETE, INV.ITEM_LOCKSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.STOCK S ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY INV.ITEM_NAME, INV.ITEM_CODE
explanation: Uses INVITEMS as the base table and LEFT JOINs STOCK, so items are shown even when no stock row exists. Missing stock values are returned as 0.

description: Current/available stock filtered by material or item name
sql_template: SELECT S.ITEMCODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, S.STOCK, S.STOCKVALUE, S.RESERVEDQTY, S.INDENTQTY, S.TRANSFERQTY, S.MILLCODE FROM INVENTORY.STOCK S JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified stock by material/item-name pattern. It joins INVENTORY.STOCK with INVENTORY.INVITEMS using STOCK.ITEMCODE = INVITEMS.ITEM_CODE and filters by INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME. STOCK.ITEMCODE is the real stock item column, not ITEM_CODE.

description: Stock summary totals filtered by material or item name
sql_template: SELECT INV.ITEM_NAME, SUM(NVL(S.STOCK, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCK, SUM(NVL(S.STOCKVALUE, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCKVALUE, SUM(NVL(S.RESERVEDQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_RESERVEDQTY, SUM(NVL(S.INDENTQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_INDENTQTY, SUM(NVL(S.TRANSFERQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_TRANSFERQTY FROM INVENTORY.STOCK S JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' GROUP BY INV.ITEM_NAME
explanation: Uses verified stock summary totals by item name.

description: Current stock for an exact item code.
sql_template: SELECT S.ITEMCODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, S.STOCK, S.STOCKVALUE, S.RESERVEDQTY, S.INDENTQTY, S.TRANSFERQTY, S.MILLCODE FROM INVENTORY.STOCK S JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(S.ITEMCODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified item-code lookup for stock. It joins INVENTORY.STOCK with INVENTORY.INVITEMS and matches the exact item code using UPPER(S.ITEMCODE).

description: Pending or open purchase order details for an exact item code.
phrases: pending purchase order for item code
sql_template: SELECT PO.ORDERNO, PO.ORDERDATE, PO.SUP_CODE, PO.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, PO.QTY, PO.RATE, PO.NET, PO.STATUS, PO.GRN_PENDINGSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON PO.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE WHERE UPPER(PO.ITEM_CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified purchase order lookup by exact item code. It joins INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER with INVENTORY.INVITEMS and filters by exact UPPER(PO.ITEM_CODE).

description: Supplier/vendor details by exact party code.
sql_template: SELECT PARTYCODE, PARTYNAME, GSTINID, PANNO, EMAIL, EMAIL1, OFFPHONE1, OFFPHONE2, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ADDRESS3, CONTPERSON1, PERPHONE1, PARTYSTATUS FROM SCM.PARTYMASTER WHERE UPPER(PARTYCODE) = '{PARTY_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified supplier/vendor lookup by exact party code. It returns supplier details from SCM.PARTYMASTER using exact UPPER(PARTYCODE).

description: Employee/staff details for an exact employee code.
sql_template: SELECT S.EMPCODE, S.EMPNAME, S.DEPTCODE, D.DEPTNAME, S.DESIGNATIONCODE, DES.DESIGNATIONNAME, S.DOJ, S.DOB, S.SEX, S.PHONENO, S.MILLCODE FROM HRDNEW.STAFF S JOIN HRDNEW.DEPARTMENT D ON S.DEPTCODE = D.DEPTCODE LEFT JOIN HRDNEW.DESIGNATION DES ON S.DESIGNATIONCODE = DES.DESIGNATIONCODE WHERE UPPER(S.EMPCODE) = '{EMPCODE}'
explanation: Uses verified exact employee code lookup. It joins HRDNEW.STAFF with HRDNEW.DEPARTMENT and HRDNEW.DESIGNATION and filters by exact UPPER(S.EMPCODE).

description: Supplier/vendor details, GST, PAN, contact, email, phone and address by party name
sql_template: SELECT PARTYCODE, PARTYNAME, GSTINID, PANNO, EMAIL, EMAIL1, OFFPHONE1, OFFPHONE2, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, ADDRESS3, CONTPERSON1, PERPHONE1, PARTYSTATUS FROM SCM.PARTYMASTER WHERE UPPER(PARTYNAME) LIKE '%{PARTY_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified supplier/vendor lookup pattern from SCM.PARTYMASTER. It filters by PARTYNAME and returns GST, PAN, contact, email, phone, address and status details.

description: Employee/staff list filtered by department name
sql_template: SELECT S.EMPCODE, S.EMPNAME, S.DEPTCODE, D.DEPTNAME, S.DESIGNATIONCODE, DES.DESIGNATIONNAME, S.DOJ, S.DOB, S.SEX, S.PHONENO, S.MILLCODE FROM HRDNEW.STAFF S JOIN HRDNEW.DEPARTMENT D ON S.DEPTCODE = D.DEPTCODE LEFT JOIN HRDNEW.DESIGNATION DES ON S.DESIGNATIONCODE = DES.DESIGNATIONCODE WHERE UPPER(D.DEPTNAME) LIKE '%{DEPT_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified employee department lookup pattern. STAFF has DEPTCODE, not DEPTNAME, so it joins HRDNEW.STAFF with HRDNEW.DEPARTMENT and filters by DEPARTMENT.DEPTNAME. DESIGNATION is joined for designation name.

description: Pending material requisition/MRS filtered by item or material name
sql_template: SELECT M.MRSNO, M.MRSDATE, M.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, M.QTY, M.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, M.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, M.DUEDATE, M.ORDERNO, M.APPROVALSTATUS, M.READYFORAPPROVAL, M.REJECTIONSTATUS, M.STORESREJECTIONSTATUS, M.REASONFORMRS FROM INVENTORY.MRS_TEMP M JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON M.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON M.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON M.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE M.MRSFLAG = 1 AND NVL(M.REJECTIONSTATUS, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.STORESREJECTIONSTATUS, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.ITEMDELETE, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.ISDELETE, 0) = 0 AND UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY M.MRSDATE DESC NULLS LAST, M.MRSNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified pending MRS pattern from INVENTORY.MRS_TEMP. It filters active non-rejected, non-deleted MRS rows and searches by INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME. Numeric status fields are shown, not compared to text.

description: Pending material requisition/MRS filtered by exact item code
phrases: latest material requisition pending for item code
latest mrs pending for item code
latest pending mrs for item code
pending material requisition for item code
material requisition pending for item code
sql_template: SELECT M.MRSNO, M.MRSDATE, M.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, M.QTY, M.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, M.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, M.DUEDATE, M.ORDERNO, M.APPROVALSTATUS, M.READYFORAPPROVAL, M.REJECTIONSTATUS, M.STORESREJECTIONSTATUS, M.REASONFORMRS FROM INVENTORY.MRS_TEMP M JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON M.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON M.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON M.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE M.MRSFLAG = 1 AND NVL(M.REJECTIONSTATUS, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.STORESREJECTIONSTATUS, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.ITEMDELETE, 0) = 0 AND NVL(M.ISDELETE, 0) = 0 AND UPPER(M.ITEM_CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}' ORDER BY M.MRSDATE DESC NULLS LAST, M.MRSNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified pending MRS pattern from INVENTORY.MRS_TEMP. It filters active non-rejected, non-deleted MRS rows and searches by exact MRS_TEMP.ITEM_CODE. Numeric status fields are shown, not compared to text.

description: GRN details filtered by exact item code
phrases: goods receipt note for item code
sql_template: SELECT G.GRNNO, G.GRNDATE, G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, G.ORDERNO, G.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, G.QTY, G.INVQTY, G.ORDERQTY, G.PENDING, G.STATUS, G.REJECTIONSTATUS, G.GRNAUTHSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.GRN G JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON G.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(G.CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified GRN lookup by exact item code. STATUS, REJECTIONSTATUS and GRNAUTHSTATUS are shown but not interpreted as text.

description: GRN details filtered by exact supplier/party code
phrases: latest goods receipt note for supplier
sql_template: SELECT G.GRNNO, G.GRNDATE, G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, G.ORDERNO, G.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, G.QTY, G.INVQTY, G.ORDERQTY, G.PENDING, G.STATUS, G.REJECTIONSTATUS, G.GRNAUTHSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.GRN G JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON G.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(G.SUP_CODE) = '{SUPPLIER_CODE}' ORDER BY G.GRNDATE DESC NULLS LAST, G.GRNNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified GRN lookup by supplier code. SUP_CODE is text/VARCHAR2, so it is compared as text.

description: GRN details filtered by purchase order number
sql_template: SELECT G.GRNNO, G.GRNDATE, G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, G.ORDERNO, G.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, G.QTY, G.INVQTY, G.ORDERQTY, G.PENDING, G.STATUS, G.REJECTIONSTATUS, G.GRNAUTHSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.GRN G JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON G.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE G.ORDERNO = {ORDER_NO}
explanation: Uses verified GRN lookup by purchase order number. ORDERNO is NUMBER, so it is compared without quotes.

description: GRN details filtered by item/material name
sql_template: SELECT G.GRNNO, G.GRNDATE, G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, G.ORDERNO, G.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, G.QTY, G.INVQTY, G.ORDERQTY, G.PENDING, G.STATUS, G.REJECTIONSTATUS, G.GRNAUTHSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.GRN G JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON G.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY G.GRNDATE DESC NULLS LAST, G.GRNNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified GRN lookup by item/material name through INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME.

description: Material issue details filtered by exact item code
sql_template: SELECT I.ISSUENO, I.ISSUEDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.INDENTNO, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.PARTYCODE, P.PARTYNAME, I.STATUS, I.RECDSTATUS, I.RECEIVEREMPCODE FROM INVENTORY.ISSUE I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON I.PARTYCODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(I.CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified material issue lookup by exact item code. ISSUE.CODE is VARCHAR2 and joins INVITEMS.ITEM_CODE. STATUS and RECDSTATUS are numeric and shown only.

description: Material issue details filtered by item/material name
sql_template: SELECT I.ISSUENO, I.ISSUEDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.INDENTNO, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.PARTYCODE, P.PARTYNAME, I.STATUS, I.RECDSTATUS, I.RECEIVEREMPCODE FROM INVENTORY.ISSUE I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON I.PARTYCODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%' ORDER BY I.ISSUEDATE DESC NULLS LAST, I.ISSUENO DESC
explanation: Uses verified material issue lookup by item/material name through INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME. STATUS and RECDSTATUS are numeric and shown only.

description: Material issue details filtered by issue number
sql_template: SELECT I.ISSUENO, I.ISSUEDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.INDENTNO, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.PARTYCODE, P.PARTYNAME, I.STATUS, I.RECDSTATUS, I.RECEIVEREMPCODE FROM INVENTORY.ISSUE I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON I.PARTYCODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE I.ISSUENO = {ISSUE_NO}
explanation: Uses verified material issue lookup by issue number. ISSUENO is NUMBER, so it is compared without quotes.

description: Material issue details filtered by indent number
sql_template: SELECT I.ISSUENO, I.ISSUEDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.INDENTNO, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPT_CODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.PARTYCODE, P.PARTYNAME, I.STATUS, I.RECDSTATUS, I.RECEIVEREMPCODE FROM INVENTORY.ISSUE I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPT_CODE = D.DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON I.PARTYCODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE I.INDENTNO = {INDENT_NO}
explanation: Uses verified material issue lookup by indent number. INDENTNO is NUMBER, so it is compared without quotes.

description: Indent details filtered by exact item code
sql_template: SELECT I.INDENTNO, I.INDENTDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.ISSUEQTY, I.INDENTCLOSEQTY, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPTCODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.STATUS, I.ISSUESTATUS, I.CANCELSTATUS, I.AUTHENTICATION, I.REMARKS FROM INVENTORY.INDENT I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPTCODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(I.CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified indent lookup by exact item code. INDENT.CODE is VARCHAR2 and joins INVITEMS.ITEM_CODE.

description: Indent details filtered by item/material name
sql_template: SELECT I.INDENTNO, I.INDENTDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.ISSUEQTY, I.INDENTCLOSEQTY, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPTCODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.STATUS, I.ISSUESTATUS, I.CANCELSTATUS, I.AUTHENTICATION, I.REMARKS FROM INVENTORY.INDENT I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPTCODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(INV.ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified indent lookup by item/material name through INVITEMS.ITEM_NAME.

description: Indent details filtered by indent number
sql_template: SELECT I.INDENTNO, I.INDENTDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.ISSUEQTY, I.INDENTCLOSEQTY, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPTCODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.STATUS, I.ISSUESTATUS, I.CANCELSTATUS, I.AUTHENTICATION, I.REMARKS FROM INVENTORY.INDENT I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPTCODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE I.INDENTNO = {INDENT_NO}
explanation: Uses verified indent lookup by indent number. INDENTNO is NUMBER, so it is compared without quotes.

description: Indent details filtered by department name
sql_template: SELECT I.INDENTNO, I.INDENTDATE, I.CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, I.QTY, I.ISSUEQTY, I.INDENTCLOSEQTY, I.UNIT_CODE, U.UNIT_NAME, I.DEPTCODE, D.DEPT_NAME, I.STATUS, I.ISSUESTATUS, I.CANCELSTATUS, I.AUTHENTICATION, I.REMARKS FROM INVENTORY.INDENT I JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON I.CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON I.UNIT_CODE = U.UNIT_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON I.DEPTCODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(D.DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%{DEPT_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified indent lookup by department name through INVENTORY.DEPT.

description: Item master details filtered by exact item code
sql_template: SELECT ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, SHORT_NAME, UOMCODE, MATGROUPCODE, STKGROUPCODE, DEPTCODE, MINQTY, MAXQTY, ROQ, OPGQTY, RECQTY, ISSQTY, STATUS, OBSOLETE, ITEM_LOCKSTATUS, HSNCODE, GSTTYPECODE FROM INVENTORY.INVITEMS WHERE UPPER(ITEM_CODE) = '{ITEM_CODE}'
explanation: Uses verified item master lookup by exact item code from INVENTORY.INVITEMS.

description: Item master details filtered by item/material name
sql_template: SELECT ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, SHORT_NAME, UOMCODE, MATGROUPCODE, STKGROUPCODE, DEPTCODE, MINQTY, MAXQTY, ROQ, OPGQTY, RECQTY, ISSQTY, STATUS, OBSOLETE, ITEM_LOCKSTATUS, HSNCODE, GSTTYPECODE FROM INVENTORY.INVITEMS WHERE UPPER(ITEM_NAME) LIKE '%{ITEM_NAME}%'
explanation: Uses verified item master lookup by item/material name from INVENTORY.INVITEMS.

show detailed stock balance with item department and unit for unit
stock balance with item department and unit for unit

explanation: Uses verified stock lookup by unit name through INVITEMS.UOMCODE and INVENTORY.UNIT.

description: Stock summary totals filtered by department name

sql_template: SELECT D.DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(NVL(S.STOCK, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCK, SUM(NVL(S.STOCKVALUE, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCKVALUE, SUM(NVL(S.RESERVEDQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_RESERVEDQTY, SUM(NVL(S.INDENTQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_INDENTQTY, SUM(NVL(S.TRANSFERQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_TRANSFERQTY FROM INVENTORY.STOCK S JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.DEPT D ON INV.DEPTCODE = D.DEPT_CODE WHERE UPPER(D.DEPT_NAME) LIKE '%{DEPT_NAME}%' GROUP BY D.DEPT_NAME
explanation: Uses verified department-wise stock summary with item count, total stock and total stock value.

description: Stock summary totals filtered by unit name
phrases: display stock summary totals for unit
sql_template: SELECT U.UNIT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT, SUM(NVL(S.STOCK, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCK, SUM(NVL(S.STOCKVALUE, 0)) AS TOTAL_STOCKVALUE, SUM(NVL(S.RESERVEDQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_RESERVEDQTY, SUM(NVL(S.INDENTQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_INDENTQTY, SUM(NVL(S.TRANSFERQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_TRANSFERQTY FROM INVENTORY.STOCK S JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON S.ITEMCODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN INVENTORY.UNIT U ON INV.UOMCODE = U.UNIT_CODE WHERE UPPER(U.UNIT_NAME) LIKE '%{UNIT_NAME}%' GROUP BY U.UNIT_NAME
explanation: Uses verified unit-wise stock summary with item count, total stock and total stock value.

sql_template: SELECT PO.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT PO.ORDERNO) AS ORDER_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS LINE_COUNT, SUM(NVL(PO.QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PO_QTY, SUM(NVL(PO.NET, 0)) AS TOTAL_PO_VALUE FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON PO.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(PO.SUP_CODE) = '{SUPPLIER_CODE}' GROUP BY PO.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME
explanation: Uses verified supplier-wise purchase order summary. SUP_CODE is VARCHAR2 and PO quantities/values are numeric totals.

description: Pending/open purchase order details filtered by supplier code
phrases: open purchase orders for supplier code
pending purchase orders for supplier code
sql_template: SELECT PO.ORDERNO, PO.ORDERDATE, PO.SUP_CODE, PO.ITEM_CODE, INV.ITEM_NAME, PO.QTY, PO.RATE, PO.NET, PO.STATUS, PO.GRN_PENDINGSTATUS FROM INVENTORY.PURCHASEORDER PO JOIN INVENTORY.INVITEMS INV ON PO.ITEM_CODE = INV.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON PO.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(PO.SUP_CODE) = '{SUPPLIER_CODE}' ORDER BY PO.ORDERDATE DESC NULLS LAST, PO.ORDERNO DESC
explanation: Uses verified pending purchase order details filtered by supplier code.

description: GRN summary totals filtered by supplier code
phrases: goods receipt summary for supplier code
goods receipt total for supplier code
grn summary totals for supplier code
goods receipt note summary totals for supplier code
supplier-wise grn summary for supplier code
supplier wise grn summary for supplier code
show grn summary totals for supplier code
sql_template: SELECT G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME, COUNT(DISTINCT G.GRNNO) AS GRN_COUNT, COUNT(*) AS LINE_COUNT, SUM(NVL(G.QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_GRN_QTY, SUM(NVL(G.INVQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_INV_QTY, SUM(NVL(G.ORDERQTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_ORDER_QTY, SUM(NVL(G.PENDING, 0)) AS TOTAL_PENDING_QTY FROM INVENTORY.GRN G LEFT JOIN SCM.PARTYMASTER P ON G.SUP_CODE = P.PARTYCODE WHERE UPPER(G.SUP_CODE) = '{SUPPLIER_CODE}' GROUP BY G.SUP_CODE, P.PARTYNAME
explanation: Uses verified supplier-wise GRN summary. SUP_CODE is VARCHAR2 and GRN quantities are numeric totals.
